entities.summary: Tyshun Raequan "Deebo" Samuel Sr. is an American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the South Carolina Gamecocks and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the second round of the 2019 NFL draft. Samuel received first-team All-Pro honors with the 49ers in 2021 and played the 2025 season with the Washington Commanders after being traded to them. He is the only wide receiver in NFL history to have 20 receiving and 20 rushing touchdowns.
